d: To operate and maintain a shovel/loader safely and efficiently for loading, transporting, stockpiling, and feeding raw materials within the sand processing plant while ensuring adherence to safety, quality, and production requirements.
q: High School Certificate or equivalent preferred
Valid Heavy Equipment Operator License (where applicable)
Certification for operating wheel loaders/shovels is an advantage
r: li
Operate shovel/loader equipment safely and efficiently in accordance with company policies and site procedures
li
Load raw materials, aggregates, and processed sand into trucks, hoppers, and designated storage areas
li
Transport materials within the plant as required to support production activities
li
Feed crushers, screens, and processing equipment with the required material
li
Maintain stockpiles and ensure proper material segregation
li
Conduct daily equipment inspections and complete pre-start checklists
li
Report equipment defects, breakdowns, or safety concerns immediately
li
Perform basic cleaning and routine maintenance of the machine
li
Ensure safe loading practices and avoid overloading trucks and equipment
li
Follow instructions from supervisors regarding production targets and operational priorities
li
Comply with all Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) regulations
li
Maintain housekeeping standards within assigned work areas
li
Assist in other plant-related activities when required
